title: Tiger Gorilla
tagline: Swing through the jungle canopy, grab the macaws and fly them home to your hungry babies, all with a chilli-powered bottom!
blurb: Swing through the jungle canopy, grab the macaws and fly them home to your hungry babies, all with a chilli-powered bottom! Vanish when the safari snappers come calling and dodge the crocs in the river. Twelve levels across three zones, a 128K title tune and music in play.

review.verdict: A cheeky, fair little jungle romp with a few colour hiccups.

quote.text: There's real thinking under all the giggling

credits.name: Marjorie Plunkett, Zippy Dee and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
